_meta: Calibrated via scripts/calibrate_armor_bands.py against 375 real legendary pieces with stats. The distribution has a hard plateau at focus 74-75 spanning p75-p95, so top_roll is set to 80 -- ABOVE the plateau -- rather than the raw p90 (75), which would have misclassified 20% of the collection as top roll. Resulting split: top_roll 3%, good 22%, ok 36%, dismantle 36%.
